newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Erbakan to go on pilgrimage to Mecca.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Erbakan to go on pilgrimage to Mecca.

text.p: Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan will go to Mecca to perform haj next week, the semi-official Anatolian news agency said on Wednesday.
Erbakan, who has performed the annual Moslem pilgrimage several times before, would leave on a private visit for Saudi Arabia on April 14 and return a week later, the agency said.

Erbakan, the first Islamist prime minister of officially secular Turkey, has called for closer links between Moslem countries and embarked on controversial visits to Iran and Libya since coming to power in June last year.
